title: Creamy Tomato, Feta and Pasta Bake
subtitle: with Dukkah Crust
description: Here's a pasta bake with all the creamy, tomatoey flavours we love, but we've crumbled feta into the mix and sprinkled the top with dukkah, an aromatic mix of sesame seeds, thyme and cumin.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the oven to 190C. Spray or brush a 1L (4 cup) baking dish with olive oil. Bring a medium saucepan of salted water to the boil for the pasta. Halve the tomatoes, put in a large bowl and gently squash with a fork to release the juices. Finely chop the onion. Crush or finely chop 1 garlic clove.

Soften onion and garlic: Heat 2 tsp olive oil in a small frypan over medium heat. Add the onion and garlic, season with salt and pepper and cook, stirring, for 5 mins or until softened. Remove the pan from the heat. Meanwhile, par-cook the pasta in the pan of boiling water for 4 minutes (see Kitchen 101). Drain well.
Prep cream mixture: Put 150ml cream and 1 egg in a large bowl and whisk to combine. Crumble in the feta, season with salt and pepper and stir to combine.
Combine pasta mixture: Add the onion mixture, pasta and tomato to the cream mixture and stir gently to combine.

Bake and serve up: Transfer the pasta mixture to the prepared baking dish and sprinkle over the dukkah. Bake for 20 mins or until the pasta is al dente and the top is slightly crispy. Divide the pasta bake among bowls and enjoy.
Kitchen 101: To avoid overcooked baked pasta, the pasta is only partially cooked at this stage – it will finish cooking in the hot sauce when baked in the oven.
